problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign packages to identical delivery trucks. Packages:
* Package 1: size 60 cubic feet
* Package 2: size 58 cubic feet
* Package 3: size 41 cubic feet
* Package 4: size 52 cubic feet
* Package 5: size 57 cubic feet
* Package 6: size 57 cubic feet
* Package 7: size 56 cubic feet
* Package 8: size 53 cubic feet
* Package 9: size 67 cubic feet
* Package 10: size 36 cubic feet
* Package 11: size 35 cubic feet
* Package 12: size 65 cubic feet
* Package 13: size 58 cubic feet
* Package 14: size 38 cubic feet
* Package 15: size 36 cubic feet
* Package 16: size 30 cubic feet
* Package 17: size 63 cubic feet
* Package 18: size 54 cubic feet
* Package 19: size 60 cubic feet
* Package 20: size 45 cubic feet
* Package 21: size 55 cubic feet
* Package 22: size 70 cubic feet
* Package 23: size 36 cubic feet
* Package 24: size 56 cubic feet
* Package 25: size 33 cubic feet
* Package 26: size 48 cubic feet
* Package 27: size 68 cubic feet

Each truck has a maximum capacity of 100 cubic feet. Load all packages using the fewest trucks possible. Every package must be placed in exactly one truck, and the total volume in any truck cannot exceed its capacity limit.
